about_the_game:
Summary

Ardent: Rise is a fantasy real-time action RPG with strong tank / damage / healing roles, and multiplayer CO-OP PVE focus.

What are the core tenets of the game?

  • Implement the "holy trinity" (Tank, Heals, Damage) archetypes in a narrative rich environment,

  • Create fun, thematic, and customizable RPG classes,

  • Focus on an exciting PVE CO-OP experience

Game Play

  • 3D semi-open world with real-time combat

  • PVE CO-OP - 5 Players

  • There are Towns and Dungeons with NPCs and enemies/bosses

  • Dungeons will provide varied enemy encounters that can be increased in difficulty for more challenging play

  • Characters can be leveled by gaining experience through exploration, quests, and interactions such as combat

  • There are loot items that you can equip, which can be gained as rewards from quests and combat, or through crafting

  • Abilities, Skills, Talents, and Professions can all be applied to customize your character capabilities

Mild narrative choices during story progression and world exploration

Visit our website to see information about Discord and sign up for the newsletter!
